name: Mouri Sonken
source:
[url=/c1752]Sonken[/url]'s(Blue) hotblooded twin. He wields a guan dao and in red clothes. His interest in stronger fighters. 

 Battle quote - "Hey hey hey hey! I've no interest in any but strong fighters!"
[Edited from [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/]Alice Soft wiki[/url]]

[spoiler]After some events he became [url=/c444]Yuma Asakura[/url]'s boyfriend.[/spoiler]
